datasets.name: Hadith grading
datasets.purpose: Hadith grades with the grader and the grading source, one entry per grader; differing grades are kept side by side.

license.name: Unlicense (repository). Rights in the grades compiled from the graders' works are not established.
license.notes: LICENSE of the repository dedicates the author's own work to the public domain; References.md shows the grades were taken from al-maktaba.org books and zubairalizai.com, whose terms were not accessible.

datasets.provenance: info.json of fawazahmed0/hadith-api tag 1, fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com 2026-10-01. Grades for Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, Malik, al-Nasa'i and al-Tirmidhi, each attributed to a named grader (Al-Albani, Zubair Ali Zai, Shuaib Al Arnaut, Ahmad Muhammad Shakir, Bashar Awad Maarouf, Abu Ghuddah, Muhammad Fouad Abd al-Baqi, Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid, Salim al-Hilali) with the repository's own reference to the source page. Bukhari and Muslim carry no grades in the file and none are added.
datasets.transformation: app/importers/hadith_grades.py: one record per hadith, grades copied verbatim in separate entries per grader; 35 placeholder grades ('-') are dropped; no grade is inferred or reconciled. Each grade also keeps the repository's own References.md line verbatim (source_reference_text), with rights_status and verification_status 'unverified'.
datasets.validation_notes: Contract validation 0 failures. The grades were NOT checked against the graders' printed works.
datasets.remaining_action: Confirm the right to redistribute these grades (or replace them with grades from a source whose terms allow it), spot-check against the graders' printed works, then mark verified and publish in Data & trust. The five collections are not loaded in the reader, so these records cite the collection and number without linking to hadith text.
alternatives_investigated: sunnah.com API requires a key and has its own terms; not accessed (host not reachable from the build environment).
Packages sunan-abi-dawud, sunan-al-nasai, sunan-ibn-majah (AGPL-3.0 declared): see docs/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md.

datasets.name: Mosques
datasets.purpose: Mosques directory (Algeria, from an open composite of Wikidata and OpenStreetMap).

license.name: Data: ODbL 1.0 (© OpenStreetMap contributors) and CC0-1.0 (Wikidata); package code: MIT
license.notes: LICENSE file of the package, dataset-metadata.json (license https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/) and README state the terms. ODbL requires attribution and share-alike for a derived database; every listing carries its attribution.

datasets.provenance: npm package @geoalgeria/mosquees 2.0.4 (sha512 integrity verified on download), built 2026-06-25 from Wikidata SPARQL (instances of mosque in Algeria with coordinates) and OpenStreetMap Overpass (amenity=place_of_worship, religion=muslim), merged within ~150 m. Community-maintained composite, not an official registry; the commune is derived by nearest-centroid join. Each listing keeps its Wikidata or OSM reference.
datasets.transformation: app/importers/geoalgeria.py maps fields 1:1 to the directory contract; 978 records with no name are skipped (no name is invented); denomination is kept only where the package took it from an OpenStreetMap tag, with that source stated; nothing is verified per listing (verification_status stays 'unverified'). Source record identifiers (GeoAlgeria id, Wikidata Q-number, OSM element) are preserved on every listing.
datasets.importer: app/importers/geoalgeria.py via scripts/run_importer.py geoalgeria-mosquees (and osm-overpass-mosques for other areas)
datasets.validation_notes: Automated checks only: licence text read; all coordinates inside Algeria's bounding box; no duplicate ids; every row has source, licence and provenance; contract validation 0 failures; scripts/validate_data.py passes. Individual mosques are NOT verified in person; listings show 'Not verified'.
datasets.import_method: scripts/run_importer.py geoalgeria-mosquees [--apply] (all-or-nothing, records source version and checksum), or Data & trust > Importers
datasets.remaining_action: Covers Algeria only. Other regions: run scripts/import_osm_mosques.py for your area on a machine that can reach the Overpass API, or upload an authorised national dataset. Individual listings become 'Verified' only through admin moderation.
alternatives_investigated: OpenStreetMap via Overpass (ODbL) is the best open source for other regions; scripts/import_osm_mosques.py is ready but Overpass is not reachable from the build environment (checked 2026-10-01).
Wikidata SPARQL (CC0) is not reachable from the build environment (checked 2026-10-01).
